facts.label: Revisão final do A2
facts.sub: Use o passado simples para o que já aconteceu, am/is/are + -ing para agora e going to para planos: I went to Texas. I’m working in a shop. I’m going to visit Brazil.

facts.label: Passado
facts.sub: Para falar do passado, use o passado simples: I went to Texas. I swam. Verbos irregulares mudam: go, went. Para perguntar, use did: Where did you go last summer?

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para falar de agora, use am/is/are + -ing: I’m working in a shop. Para hábitos, use o presente simples: I study at night. Pergunte What are you doing now?

items.s: “I went” is the past of go.
We say “I am go to Brazil”.
items.why: We say I am going to go.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “I went” is the past of go. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I am go to Brazil”. → Falso (We say I am going to go.)
“Warmer than” compares two things. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

paragraphs: It is Friday afternoon in a quiet school in Boston. Sunlight fills the empty class. Max sits at his desk with a big smile. His teacher Ian walks in with a cup of tea. It is the last class of the year. Ian wants to talk about the English journey.
